narrative: 结束在叙事的关键点上，而不是一面墙上。向右的转动可以跟随一个眼神、一辆车，或一句指向画外的台词。
因为摄影机没有移动，这个镜头的伦理立场始终是一个可以转头却无法跟随的目击者。如果你需要的是必须匹配速度的追逐戏，或者需要用运动模糊来充当剪辑点的惊悚点，那么这就不是合适的工具。
how: 液压云台，只做偏航旋转，水平线保持水平，在构图完整的结束画面上做柔化停止。如果摇镜过程中会经过一扇窗户，要留意曝光的变化。
提示词：从锁定的三脚架上缓慢向右摇，液压云台旋转，水平线保持水平，连续的水平方向揭示。
when: 与向左摇的作用相同，只是方向相反。结束在叙事的关键点上。
具体场景：一个说话者说完，摇镜头找到即将做出决定的倾听者。不要摇过头之后再来回搜索。
vs: 向左摇（Pan Left）是方向相反的同一种旋转。推轨右移（Dolly Right）则是让机身本身平移。
甩镜头（Whip Pan）是在同一条轴线上刻意制造模糊。如果支撑装置发生了滑动，那就已经不属于摇镜头这个家族了。
examples_film: 《血色将至》（There Will Be Blood）在室内和地景之间转动镜头，把石油、祈祷和土地绑定在同一个站位之上。《游戏规则》（The Rules of the Game）用流畅的摇镜穿越城堡，让阶级和狩猎共享同一片深焦空间。
要学的是转动本身的语法，而不是照搬某种场景布局。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是推轨右移，或者一个始终没有落定的甩镜头。破绽在于出现了不该有的视差，或者模糊始终没有干脆地停下来。
解决办法：锁定三脚架，只做向右的偏航旋转，水平线保持水平，画面干净地落定。

faq.q: 电影中的向右摇（Pan Right）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机在固定三脚架上向右做偏航旋转，水平扫过画面，而支撑装置本身不移动。

faq.q: 向右摇（Pan Right）与推轨右移（Dolly Right）的区别
faq.a: 推轨右移是让摄影机在X轴上改变位置。向右摇则只是旋转，因此你是从同一个地点、同一个位置去看这个地方的新的部分。

faq.q: 什么时候该用向右摇（Pan Right）？
faq.a: 当下一个叙事信息在右侧、一次转动就足以连接它时使用。不要用它来伪造一次沿街道的横移。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写向右摇（Pan Right）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：固定三脚架，向右摇，只做水平旋转，水平线保持水平，机身不移动。并说明最终落定的画面。

narrative: End on the story beat, not on a wall. The rightward turn can follow a look, a car, or a line of dialogue that points off-screen.

Because the camera does not walk, the ethics of the shot stay those of a witness who can turn but cannot follow. It is the wrong tool for a chase that must match pace, and the wrong tool for a sting that needs motion blur as a cut.
how: Fluid head, yaw only, horizon level, feathered stop on a composed end frame. Keep exposure in mind if you pan into a window.
Prompt a slow pan right from a locked tripod, fluid head rotation, level horizon, a continuous horizontal reveal.
when: Same job as pan left, other direction. End on the story beat.
Concrete beat: a speaker finishes, the pan finds the listener who will decide. Do not overshoot and hunt.
vs: Pan Left is the mirrored yaw. A Dolly Right trucks the body.
A Whip Pan blurs this same axis on purpose. If the support slides, you left the pan family.
examples_film: There Will Be Blood turns across interiors and landscapes to bind oil, prayer, and land in one station. The Rules of the Game uses fluid pans through the chateau so class and hunting share deep space.
Grammar of the turn, not a layout to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Right or a Whip Pan that never resolves. The tell is parallax you did not want, or blur that never hard-stops.
The fix: locked sticks, yaw right, level horizon, clean settle.

faq.q: What is Pan Right in film?
faq.a: It is a rightward yaw of the camera on a fixed tripod, sweeping the view horizontally without moving the support.
Dolly right relocates the camera on an X axis. Pan right only rotates, so you look at a new part of the same place from the same spot.

faq.q: When should I use Pan Right?
faq.a: When the next fact is to the right and a turn is enough to connect it. Do not use it to fake a track along a street.

faq.q: How do I prompt Pan Right for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write fixed tripod, pan right, horizontal rotation only, level horizon, no body travel. Name the landing frame.
